human_operator.name: Interactive terminal/TUI
human_operator.summary: OpenCode provides an interactive terminal UI with build and plan agents.

evidence.claim: OpenCode provides an interactive terminal UI with build and plan agents.

human_operator.name: IDE integration
human_operator.summary: OpenCode is available through IDE integration.

evidence.claim: OpenCode is available through IDE integration.

human_operator.name: Desktop or web surface
human_operator.summary: OpenCode provides a desktop application and shareable session links.

evidence.claim: OpenCode provides a desktop application and shareable session links.

human_operator.name: Agent-native file editing

human_operator.name: Agent-native shell execution
human_operator.summary: Agents can run commands subject to permission configuration.

evidence.claim: Agents can run commands subject to permission configuration.

human_operator.name: Headless/non-interactive execution
human_operator.summary: OpenCode supports non-interactive run and GitHub automation modes.

evidence.claim: OpenCode supports non-interactive run and GitHub automation modes.
